subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can listen and colour a robot.
I can describe a robot: I've got a blue head.
I can draw a robot and write about it.

tf.s: In the listening, the robot has got a blue head.
tf.why: I've got a blue head and a brown face.

tf.s: In the listening, the robot has got a green face.
tf.why: The robot has got a brown face.

tf.s: In the listening, the robot's hands are red.
In the listening, the robot has got black feet.
tf.why: Green legs, blue knees and black feet.

tf.s: In the listening, the robot's knees are red.
"I've got four arms" matches a robot with two arms.
tf.why: Two arms is not four arms, so we put a cross.

tf.s: "I've got a blue body and green arms" has two body parts.
tf.why: Body and arms are two body parts.

tf.s: A robot can have ten fingers.
tf.why: I've got ten fingers is in the lesson.

boxes.q: What colour is the robot's head?
What colour is the robot's face?
What colour are the robot's arms?
What colour are the robot's hands?
What colour are the robot's knees?
What colour are the robot's feet?

boxes.why: "a" goes with one thing: a red head.

boxes.q: Read: I've got ten fingers. Picture: ten fingers.

mcq.q: Which sentence describes the robot's head?
mcq.why: The robot has got a blue head.

mcq.q: What colour is the robot's body?
How do we start a sentence about our robot?
Your robot has got green legs. What do you write?
mcq.why: I've got + colour + plural body part.

mcq.q: Say a sentence with two body parts and colours.
o: I've got a blue body and green arms.
mcq.why: Name each colour and body part.

mcq.q: Read: I've got four arms. The robot has got two arms. Tick or cross?
mcq.why: Two arms do not match four arms.

mcq.q: Why do we say "a blue head" but "blue knees"?
o: We have one head and two knees.

mcq.q: Which is a full description of the robot's legs, knees and feet?
o: green legs, blue knees and black feet
blue legs, green knees and red feet
black legs, red knees and blue feet
red legs, black knees and green feet
mcq.why: The listening says green legs, blue knees and black feet.
